verdict.rationale: Codegen's agent can analyze requirements and create new tasks in Jira, Linear, ClickUp and Monday.com, and its agents can present structured implementation plans. This gives a first-party path from a prompt to a structured task, but nothing documents ingesting user feedback submissions specifically or attaching a proposed scope to the tasks it creates. Missing for 10: a documented feedback-intake workflow, proposed-scope fields or estimation on generated tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope

citations.quote: Update statuses, add comments, link PRs to issues, and create new tasks. Support for Jira, Linear, Clickup and Monday.com.
Generate new tasks automatically based on development needs and project requirements
Analyze requirements, implement features, fix bugs, write tests, and improve documentation based on your prompts.
Agents will present a structured plan showing each implementation step
